name: LANE_DIVIDES_SYMBOL_YELLOW_LONG

nsw_t5-209n_lane_divides.desc: straight-on arrow with a lane diverging down to the right and a red closed-lane bar, 480 x 311 overall (symbol detail on a 30 mm grid)

notes: TfNSW plan T5-209n (Roads & Maritime 2019 sheet, text outlined): 600 x 450, square corners, black border 25 ('25' corner mark), yellow ground. Lane-divides symbol traced from the sheet in two colour layers (black arrows, red bar); the sheet dimensions only 60 / 407 / 26 / 106 across (symbol from 60, red bar ending 132 from the right) and 154 / 37 / 233 down (red bar 37 high from 154), so the symbol's overall box (60 to 540 across, 69 to 380 down) was measured on the sheet.
